history.title: Example atlas from the Archi sample model
history.summary: First build of the ArchiSurance example: imported from the Archi sample model, mapped to the insurance pack, with illustrative suppliers, costs, journeys, regulation, change portfolio and a consolidation programme.

changes.text: Applications, platforms, roles, processes, data objects and interfaces imported from Archisurance.archimate
Insurance pack capability map (11 domains, 61 L2, 143 L3) mapped to the applications
Goals and principles from the Archi model as strategic pillars and initiatives
DORA, Solvency II review and EU AI Act requirements mapped to the estate
